subject.title: Exact deployment identity and Product QA acceptance snapshot

objective: Prove Product QA tests the exact deployed FE/BE artifacts/configuration by binding one immutable DeploymentRelease into an AcceptanceSnapshot and independently observing runtime identity before QualityAcceptance.
architectureDecisions: source revision, build artifact, image tag, immutable artifact digest, DeploymentRelease and observed runtime identity are distinct
DeploymentRelease is DevOps authoritative publication of exact deployables/configuration/evidence; it is not Product QA truth
AcceptanceSnapshot is deterministic/immutable and derived from one exact DeploymentRelease plus current acceptance subjects
caller/QA cannot omit mandatory components or mix component refs from different releases unless explicit policy permits
QA independently observes runtime identity; DevOps/app self-report alone is insufficient
mixed old/new rollout blocks/inconclusive by default
QA revalidates deployment/currentness and runtime identity before effects and before QualityAcceptance publication
old snapshots/acceptances remain historical after newer release; they are not current for the new release

requiredExisting: delivered Integration C semantic lineage/currentness source
delivered Integration D FE/BE domain delivery/publication source

implementationSlices.output: DeployableArtifactRef + BuildProvenance resolution for exact FE/BE immutable digests
requirements: mutable tag/branch alone cannot satisfy correctness identity
sourceDeliveryRef and build provenance remain linked to exact deployable digest

implementationSlices.output: DevOps domain-local deployment execution + immutable DeploymentRelease/currentness
requirements: bind exact FE/BE deployables, environment, deployment spec/config refs, rollout/health evidence and expected runtime identities
first source delivery may use deterministic deployment fixture adapter; no universal deployment platform is required
DevOps cannot produce Product QA verdict
derive required FE+BE components from exact DeploymentRelease and acceptance policy
observe tested environment independently from DeploymentRelease self-report
support exact digest/runtime identity evidence; Kubernetes imageID/digest may be one adapter, not universal semantics
mixed or unknown runtime identity blocks/inconclusive by default

implementationSlices.output: Product QA WorkContract bound to AcceptanceSnapshot + immutable QualityAcceptance
requirements: pre-QA and pre-publication deployment/currentness/runtime rechecks close shifting-environment race
QualityAcceptance references exact runtime observations and criterion evidence

hardInvariants: caller-selected ref list cannot omit mandatory snapshot components
deployment change during QA cannot produce current acceptance for newer release
acceptanceCriteria: exact FE/BE deployable digests are traceable from accepted source delivery/build provenance into one DeploymentRelease
AcceptanceSnapshot deterministically pins exact release, components, criteria, environment and verifier policy
QA independently observes runtime identity and rejects/blocks mismatch or mixed rollout
deployment revision change before QA start prevents current run; change during QA prevents current QualityAcceptance publication
old snapshot/acceptance remains reconstructable historical evidence after newer release
fresh process can trace SourceDelivery -> BuildProvenance -> DeployableDigest -> DeploymentRelease -> AcceptanceSnapshot -> RuntimeObservation -> QualityAcceptance
mandatoryNegativeTests: mutable image tag satisfies exact identity
snapshot omits Backend or Frontend required by policy
snapshot mixes components from different releases
DevOps self-report alone proves runtime identity
mixed B4+B5 rollout accepted when snapshot expects B5
deployment changes during QA but old tests publish current ACCEPT
source commit sameness overrides deployable digest mismatch
forbidden: Sigstore/in-toto runtime dependency solely for this slice

activation.baselinePolicy: Resolve the exact current source baseline at allocation time and bind both semanticInputRef and this implementation spec from current.json. Do not reuse the origin planning baseline.
